rfi_drafts.subject: Glazing at interior storefront openings C and D
rfi_drafts.body: Storefront Opening Schedule (A-6.1) lists 1" insulating glass for openings C (Waiting/Service Bays) and D (Office/Service Bays), both interior. Please confirm whether 1/4" clear tempered monolithic glass is acceptable at interior openings, or whether 1" IGU is intended.

rfi_drafts.subject: Door D8 frame glazing
